item.title: Sault police investigating sudden death in creek near Second Line West
item.description: Person found deceased in creek near Hampton Road Saturday evening; police say no foul play suspected.

item.title: Harnden brothers sweep to another Brier title with Dunstone
item.description: Ryan and E.J. Harnden add another championship to their decorated careers as Matt Dunstone’s Manitoba rink defeats Kevin Koe 6-3 in the 2026 Brier final.

item.title: New passenger train petition targets federal and provincial governments
item.description: Advocates look to both governments for shared infrastructure, operational funding for Northern passenger rail service.

item.title: Chop, chop: Ice-breaking on St. Mary's River to launch Monday
item.description: To extend into southern half of West Neebish Channel and, as week progresses, from Mud Lake Junction Light northward to Moon Island

item.title: MONIN: D’Arcy McGee’s diplomacy set tone for calm, cool Canadian character
item.description: Willingness to compromise, avoid overly heated political rhetoric has defined our country

item.title: John Dean eyes Soo Greyhounds ‘getting their swagger back’ as playoffs near
item.description: Greyhounds take four of six points on road trip as coach points to positives — and a possible Chase Reid return — with playoffs fast approaching.
